items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: There was a guy there by the name of Larman Mundy, who was a trumpet player and there were seven of us.

ctx.x: This was a pit band job?

-- for the pit band. You know, we had to play a show. Now this is before I met Baby Lovett. There was a guy there by the name of Larman Mundy, who was a trumpet player and there were seven of us. I can't remember all the names of the other guys right offhand but the proprietor asked us, said, "You fellows read, don't you"? I've got a show to play", and we said, "Yeah". Everybody spoke up, is "Yeah, we can supposed to read. "Bring us the music" Okay, so he did but with the music, when he brought the music he…

He said, "The only reason I'm asking you fellows this is because you have a -- you guys look nice and everything but I have had bands to come in this place that couldn't read a note and believe me, they were some of the greatest musicians I've ever heard and how they played without reading music I don't know".
